Definitely come with an open mind — set aside your urban, Western mindset and embrace the spirit of true travel.

Delicious Bun Cha and Noodles
Jan 2023 • Family
We were recommended this place by locals.

It’s very easy to miss down small alley roads and inbetween bars and other street stalls.

The place has plastic tables and chairs street stall/hawker style but is super authentic and yummy.

Pricing is super cheap as you would imagine and you get heaps of noodles and a big serving of bun cha (pork in a sour broth), our kids loved it as well, definitely worth a visit.
